PRACTICAL BUDAPEST EXAMPLES

Quote tracking and real business return.

Clicks alone do not pay the bills. What matters is when incoming calls and quotation requests turn into paid work. The following examples show the practical business value of transparent tracking.

EXAMPLE 01 · DISTRICTS XI & XXII

Heating and boiler service

Starting point: Monthly advertising budget was spent with zero visibility into whether incoming phone calls originated from paid ads or word of mouth.

Actions taken: Source-based call logging and a 4-column quotation status board introduced for the dispatch team.

Result: Wasted spend was identified and reallocated, resulting in 30% more won repair jobs on the exact same ad budget.

EXAMPLE 02 · DISTRICT XIII

Window replacement and glazing

Starting point: Over 60 quote requests per month, but due to slow response times, only 15% of prospective customers progressed to an on-site survey.

Actions taken: 24-hour callback standard introduced alongside instant confirmation messaging upon quote submission.

Result: Survey booking rate increased from 15% to 42%, doubling signed installation contracts within weeks.

EXAMPLE 03 · DISTRICTS II & XII

Premium security systems

Starting point: For residential villa alarm installations in Buda, customer decisions took weeks, and sent quotes often went cold.

Actions taken: Structured 7-day and 14-day consultation follow-up routine introduced with personal phone check-ins.

Result: 28% of stalled quotes converted into closed contracts without spending an extra forint on advertising.

BOUNDARIES AND TRANSPARENCY

Data ethics and decision support

We do not use intrusive surveillance tracking or unauthorised user profiling. We work strictly with verified marketing tools and the operational feedback provided by your own team. The focus is on continuously improving quotation win rates.

Frequently asked questions

Do we need expensive CRM software?

Not necessarily. For most local service businesses, a disciplined, well-maintained spreadsheet provides far greater clarity than expensive enterprise software.

How do we know which ad drove a phone call?

We use dedicated call tracking numbers or a simple customer intake question to identify the marketing source reliably.

What if a customer does not recall where they found us?

We combine technical attribution signals with intake notes; 100% source identification is impossible, but dominant channels become very clear.

How often do we review the numbers together?

We review the data monthly: spend vs sent quotations vs closed revenue, making sure budget goes toward the highest-margin services.

What is Win Rate and why does it matter more than ad clicks?

Win rate measures what percentage of submitted quotes turn into paying customers. When your closing process is disciplined and timely, business revenue grows significantly without increasing ad spend.

How is customer privacy protected during tracking?

We only log operational details needed for direct communication on secure, restricted systems, strictly adhering to GDPR and local privacy regulations.
